column1: # The reference's own inventories, extracted from the installed CLI 2.1.257.
# Hook events come from the array that declares all of them; commands from the
# type:"local"/"local-jsx"/"prompt" objects, read at the name nearest each.
# A few entries are minified identifiers the extraction cannot tell from a command.
# They are stable, so they are recorded here rather than failing every run — the
# point of this file is that a real new command shows up as a new line.
